module: Flowgraph node "Race Data" (category repeat_instant, tag scenario). Exposes race data for a vehicle (raceData.states[vehId]): formattedTime (time formatted via race:raceTime, computed only if the pin is used), recoveriesUsed, placement and isOnRoad (true as long as the vehicle is within the AI path limits; a single false tick is masked).

work.desc: Every frame: reads the vehicle's state in the race and fills the four output pins.
